step1.title: How will you use Apex?
step1.subtitle: One person can hold several roles (e.g. a coach who also trains).

step1.coachDesc: Coach athletes, author training blocks, manage workload.
step1.specialistDesc: Dietetics, physiotherapy, strength & conditioning, psychology, physician.

step3.title: How do you log your data?
step3.subtitle: You can change this setting anytime in Settings.
step3.deviceCardDesc: Garmin, WHOOP, Apple Health, Polar background sync.
step3.manualCardDesc: No sensor device needed; log workouts and recovery via quick forms.
step3.hybridCardDesc: Wearable sensor sync combined with manual subjective feedback.

step4.subtitle: Select all support modes that apply (multi-select).
step4.soloDesc: Apex acts as your virtual coach and intelligent assistant.

step5.subtitle: Helps establish your biological baseline to detect anomalies.

step6.title: Nutrition Basics
step6.subtitle: Timed nutrition to maximize athletic recovery.
step6.plateBasedToggle: Hide calorie numbers, show plate-based view only
step6.plateBasedDesc: Hides numerical calorie counts and shows visual plate portions (protein, carbs, vegetables).

step7.title: Health Data Consent (GDPR Art. 9)
step7.subtitle: Highest standard of data privacy and medical ethics in elite sport.
step7.legalText: For effective training periodization, recovery modeling, and injury prevention, Apex processes special categories of personal data (health and biometric data, e.g. heart rate, sleep duration, menstrual cycle, injuries) pursuant to GDPR Article 9(2)(a).
step7.guarantees: We guarantee your biometric and health data is never sold to third parties, never used for advertising, and is accessible only to you and authorized staff you explicitly invite.
step7.consentCheckbox: I explicitly consent to the processing of my health and biometric data for athletic preparation and recovery analysis.
step7.requiredError: You must accept the health data consent to complete onboarding.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & GDPR Art. 9
privacy.subtitle: Processing of special category biometric and health data in elite sport
privacy.controllerText: The Apex team is committed to the highest standards of athlete privacy. We collect data strictly for athletic performance optimization and injury prevention.
privacy.categoriesText: Profile information (name, email, sports, competition tier), biometrics (resting HR, HRV, sleep metrics, body mass), subjective markers (soreness, fatigue, stress), and nutrition records.
privacy.legalBasisText: Explicit, informed, and revocable consent under GDPR Article 9(2)(a).
privacy.rightsText: You can view your data anytime, export it in JSON format (data portability), or permanently erase your account and all stored records with one click.

pwa.installDesc: Add Apex to your home screen for blazing speed and offline access.
pwa.updateDesc: The latest Apex improvements are ready. Reload now to update.

sharing.title: Who Sees What? (Sharing Settings)
sharing.subtitle: The athlete owns all data. Coaches and specialists see only what you explicitly grant, per module.
sharing.corePrincipleDesc: Your preparation data belongs solely to you. Staff members only see modules you explicitly enable. Coaches cannot access the health module (injuries, medical notes) unless you explicitly grant it.
sharing.noStaff: You currently have no connected coaches or specialists.
sharing.healthNotice: Special protection: the health module (injuries, diagnostics, medical notes) is strictly blocked unless explicitly enabled.
sharing.revokeConfirmDesc: The staff member will immediately lose access to all your data. This revocation is recorded in your audit log.
sharing.auditLogDesc: Immutable, timestamped record of all permission changes, acceptances, and revocations.
sharing.codeGeneratedDesc: Share this code with your coach or specialist. The code is valid for 7 days.
